commitment_encoding: cases_sha256 hashes UTF-8 file bytes including trailing newline; added_cases_commitment hashes canonical sorted compact UTF-8 JSON without trailing newline
comparison: All 24 previous cases retained unchanged; 22 prior math tasks and two boundary controls separate from six added neighbors. Only 3/3 same-task success pairs compare cost; report every regression/fallback.
environment_binding: Record and compare Python/NumPy version, NumPy show_config, requested thread controls and available threadpool runtime information at freeze and both run boundaries.
execution: Cold processes, alternate system order across case and repetition, serial only, process-group 10-second hard deadline including import/solve/JSON/full replay/output
resource_policy: wait4 CPU includes reaped descendants, do not double count; memory is largest observable process high water, not simultaneous tree sum; forced termination resource coverage can be incomplete
route_policy: Separate native_c3, reused_c2, reused_c1 and baseline_fallback; retain detailed route chain and all failed attempts
sealing: Six added case parameters remain undisclosed to developers until source freeze; shared directory is discipline isolation, not permissions isolation. No pre-run solver screening.
source_scope: Exact previous frozen union plus new implementation Python outside evaluation/notes/review and protocol/cases; output directories never join source set.
task_binding: Frozen baseline.assess against original task plus exact endpoint/error recomputation; solver status is not mathematical evidence
token_policy: No model API calls; actual model/cached tokens unknown; JSON bytes are not tokens
